name: luci-app-snort3
description: LuCI JavaScript frontend and rpcd/ucode backend for Snort3 on OpenWrt

scripts.build:lmo: node scripts/po2lmo.js po/de/snort.po dist/lmo/snort.de.lmo && node scripts/po2lmo.js po/es/snort.po dist/lmo/snort.es.lmo && node scripts/po2lmo.js po/fr/snort.po dist/lmo/snort.fr.lmo && node scripts/po2lmo.js po/pt_BR/snort.po dist/lmo/snort.pt-br.lmo && node scripts/po2lmo.js po/ru/snort.po dist/lmo/snort.ru.lmo && node scripts/po2lmo.js po/zh_Hans/snort.po dist/lmo/snort.zh-cn.lmo
scripts.check: npm run check:js && npm run test && npm run check:i18n
